one_liner: Nifty 50 dips 0.44% amid mixed sectoral performance and rising volatility.

drivers.title: No Catalyst
drivers.detail: No identifiable catalyst for market movements.

drivers.detail: Nifty FMCG rose 1.21%, leading sectoral gains.
